title: Nodes on the ARPANET, December 1969 to July 1977
description: Bar chart of the number of network nodes (IMPs and TIPs) on each of BBN's maps. December 1969, 4; June 1970, 9; December 1970, 13; September 1971, 18; March 1972, 23; August 1972, 29; September 1973, 40; June 1974, 46; July 1975, 57; July 1976, 58; July 1977, 58. Data: Heart, McKenzie, McQuillan and Walden, ARPANET Completion Report (BBN Report 4799), figure 16.
heading: NODES ON THE ARPANET · BBN'S MAPS
